hypothesis.direction: Short failed gap-up; long failed gap-down.
hypothesis.entry_event: First completed close showing rejection after 09:30 and before 10:15.
hypothesis.hypothesis_name: Gap rejection reversal after failed first-30-minute acceptance
hypothesis.invalidation: Gap resumes beyond opening extreme before entry.
hypothesis.known_prior_research: Related to mean reversion but not generic VWAP extension; premise is failed overnight gap inventory.
hypothesis.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after rejection close.
hypothesis.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Candidate identity depends on prior-close gap failure, not stretch-from-VWAP or ORB retest.
hypothesis.negative_expectation_falsifier: Reversal returns fail WFA/control separation or are concentrated in few sessions.
hypothesis.participants_or_behavior: Opening gap chasers unwind; liquidity providers fade failed displacement; hedgers reduce directional exposure.
hypothesis.persistence_rationale: Failed gap acceptance creates predictable inventory pain when price crosses back through prior close/opening midpoint.
hypothesis.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from legal entry close to +45 completed minutes.
hypothesis.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC candles; prior-session close; completed first 30 bars.
setup_state_machine: WAIT for gap open and first 30 completed bars
REJECT if price closes back inside 25% of prior-close gap or crosses prior close
EMIT reversal at first completed rejection close
hypothesis.single_emission_rule: At most one candidate per symbol-session.
hypothesis.structural_premise: A gap that cannot hold through the first 30 minutes indicates trapped directional open inventory and mean reversion pressure.
